description: Read recent integration webhook and sync activity, newest first. This is the log to check when an integration reports connected but contacts or events are not appearing: each row carries the action, status, event type, matched contact, and error. Payloads are sanitized at write time, so no credentials or secrets appear here. Activity is retained for 24 hours only.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

integrationId.description: Only show activity for this integration.

provider.description: Only show activity for this provider, for example `stripe`.

status.description: Filter by status: received, queued, processed, skipped, or failed. Use `failed` to triage a broken integration.

name: list_integration_activity

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_integration_activity` MCP tool.

activity.description: List of integration activity row, including provider, action, status, event type, matched contact, message, and error. Payloads are sanitized, so no credentials appear records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

windowHours.description: Retention window in hours for integration activity.
